## Timeline & Phases

### Phase 0: Project Intake (Week 1)
- Project charter approval
- Team assembly
- Initial requirements gathering

### Phase 1: Requirements & Discovery (Weeks 2-3)
- Detailed requirements documentation
- User research
- Technical feasibility study

### Phase 2: Design & Architecture (Weeks 4-5)
- System architecture design
- UI/UX design
- Database schema design

### Phase 3: Development (Weeks 6-9)
- Backend implementation
- Frontend implementation
- Integration

### Phase 4: Testing (Week 10)
- Unit testing
- Integration testing
- User acceptance testing

### Phase 5: Deployment (Week 11)
- Production deployment
- Monitoring setup
- Documentation

### Phase 6: Post-Launch (Week 12+)
- Monitoring and optimization
- User feedback incorporation
- Iteration
